from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfitRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single record extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company in the report")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by this report")
    total_profit_amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported value of Total Profit (利润总额)")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency or unit of the reported amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_profit_records: list[CompanyProfitRecord]
